h: Shabbos Restores the Faith and Holiness of Yerushalayim

p: "Who spreads the shelter of peace over us
and over all Yisrael and over Yerushalayim,"
even though at this time Yisrael are in exile,
"Zion shall be plowed as a field,
and Yerushalayim shall become heaps of ruins,
and the Temple Mount like the high places of a forest."
is the holiness of the camp of Yisrael,
and it is written regarding the eating of ma'aser (Devarim 14:23):
"So that you may learn to fear, etc.,"
שֶׁמֶּלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
that the King of kings, HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
stands over him and sees his deeds
(as the Rema wrote at the beginning of Orach Chayim).
That is, Yerushalayim is the trait of Malchus,
as is written in the holy Zohar
(as is written in the holy Zohar, I 5b);
וְיֵשׁ יִרְאָה שֶׁהוּא כְּמוֹרָה בָּשָׂר וָדָם
And there is a fear that is like the fear of flesh and blood
וְהוּא גַּם כֵּן עַל יְדֵי אֱמוּנָה
and it too is through faith:
although He is not before his eyes,
he believes that Hashem Yisbarach sees his deeds;
and this is what is written
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
that is, that he take to heart
stands over him constantly and sees his deeds
immediately fear will come to him,
more than the fear of flesh and blood.
And this is what his students said (there):
for there is fear and faith greater than this,
more than the fear of flesh and blood.
And this is in the sense of (Tamid 28a):
"Let him hold fast to extra faith,
'My eyes are upon the faithful of the land.'"
until he is called after it "faithful."
that is, Yerushalayim is called "the faithful city"
for there is the dwelling of fear,
as it says, "So that you may learn to fear."
certainly this is HaKadosh Baruch Hu;
"Tzedek is known to be judgment, etc.;
mishpat is known to be mercy."
And it is written "filled with justice,"
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (יְשַׁעְיָה ו, ג)
the whole earth is full of His glory,"
and we translate it in the Targum:
"The whole earth is full of the radiance of His glory."
as is written in the holy Zohar;
and it says "the whole earth is full,"
for when the holiness of Hashem Yisbarach is revealed,
then all of Knesses Yisrael is filled
with the radiance of His glory,
And in Yerushalayim there was the holiness of the wall,
as in the generation of the wilderness,
the encircling by the Clouds of Glory;
was the holiness of the camp of Yisrael,
and even the least of Yisrael
was filled with the radiance of His glory.
And likewise Shabbos is complete faith,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
as is written (in the holy Zohar II 88a):
and on the Field of holy Apples"
ג׳ קְדוּשּׁוֹת שֶׁל ג׳ סְעוּדוֹת שַׁבָּת
the three holinesses of the three Shabbos meals,
"the whole earth full of the radiance of His glory";
and as they said (Yerushalmi, chapter 4 of Demai):
"The awe of Shabbos is upon the am ha'aretz"
as in the wilderness, in the camp of Yisrael,
within the encircling Clouds of Glory,
And this is why it says
עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם
"over us and over all Yisrael and over Yerushalayim":
"their holiness remains even when they are desolate"
it is also called "the faithful city."
and they are called "the meals of faith"
(as is written in the holy Zohar there).
And this is what it says:
"He is truth and He is faith."
For the Yerushalmi refers to the Mishnah:
"And on Shabbos he may ask him and eat it on his word,"
for the awe of Shabbos is upon the am ha'aretz,
and he does not lie on Shabbos.
And this is what it says:
יֵשׁ לוֹ בְּשַׁבָּת חֵלֶק בְּמִדַּת אֱמֶת
has on Shabbos a share in the trait of truth.
Yisrael are a chariot for the trait of Malchus,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
as we find with Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
for he became a chariot for the Name Havayah;
in sleep and in a dream
merited all the wisdom of Shlomo,
"So He gives to His beloved in sleep";
and that is King Shlomo, alav hashalom,
וְזָכָה לְכָל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה בַּחֲלוֹם
and he merited all of Torah she'b'al peh in a dream.
And Hashem Yisbarach is called here
it is entirely "Who is good and does good";
בְּיוֹם הָנִיחַ ה׳ לְךָ מֵעָצְבְּךָ וְגוֹ׳
"On the day that Hashem gives you rest from your toil, etc.,
which is expounded in the holy Zohar
as referring to the Shabbos day,
which is called "the day He gives rest":
is in the midst of hard labor,
he recognizes that he is not under subjugation,
רַק אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָתָּה
but rather "we have no King but You";
and as a matter of course on Shabbos
it is entirely "Who is good and does good."
that it is entirely "Who is good and does good."
for Hashem Yisbarach rests His Shechinah in Yisrael,
and even in a dream, in sleep,
a Jew is a chariot for the Name Havayah,
אֲנִי ה׳ שֹׁכֵן וְגוֹ׳ (בְּמִדְבַּר לה, לד)
this too alludes to this trait,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קפ, ב)
and as they said, "On Shabbos he may ask him," etc.,
for certainly a Jew will speak truth on Shabbos.
